profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp. is a public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, traded under the ticker ZBRA. On its own site the company describes itself as a foundation for intelligent operations, saying it powers intelligent operations to digitize, automate, and enhance processes with mobile computers, scanners, printers, and RFID. It also markets manufacturing technology solutions that combine hardware and software for automation, data analysis, and factory connectivity.

Its AI offerings, as the site describes them, include AI software solutions for frontline operations that optimize workflows and simplify tasks, Zebra Companion AI for tailored insights and support, and Frontline AI Enablers consisting of AI vision models, sample apps, and APIs. The company also lists Frontline AI Blueprints, described as adaptable frameworks that automate manual tasks, and the Zebra Aurora suite of machine vision software, including Aurora Focus, an interface for setting up, deploying, and running its Fixed Industrial Scanners and Machine Vision Smart Cameras. Zebra says its AI is an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software, and machine vision.

The company's litigation record shows 374 cases in Illinois, with no other jurisdictions listed. No product entries or other case records are associated with it in the material reviewed.
